description: Position GPS des arrêts de bus d'Auxerre is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Hooger SAS. Name of the stop, latitude and longitude of the stops of the city of Auxerre (Vivacité). Coverage: Hooger SAS. The portal shows the English title as "GPS location of Auxerre bus stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Hooger SAS. Its keywords include lignes, positions, bus, longitude, latitude. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2016-02-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
